title: Area formula for an injective immersion of a measurable subset of ℝ × ℝ into ℝ^P
statement:
Let P ∈ ℕ, G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ^P, and let R ⊆ ℝ × ℝ be measurable. Assume G is differentiable at every q ∈ R with injective derivative DG(q) : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ^P, and G is injective on R. Write ∂₁G(q) := DG(q)(1, 0) and ∂₂G(q) := DG(q)(0, 1).

Then for every function h : ℝ^P → ℝ:
∫_{G(R)} h dH² = ∫_R (‖∂₁G(q)‖²‖∂₂G(q)‖² − ⟨∂₁G(q), ∂₂G(q)⟩²)^{1/2} · h(G(q)) dq.

Here H² = μHE[2] on ℝ^P and dq is the product Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝ × ℝ. Both sides are Bochner integrals; no integrability is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → Euclid P) (R : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet R → (∀ q ∈ R, DifferentiableAt ℝ G q) → (∀ q ∈ R, Injective (fderiv ℝ G q)) → InjOn G R → ∫ x in G '' R, h x ∂μHE[2] = ∫ q in R, Real.sqrt (‖fderiv ℝ G q (1, 0)‖ ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ G q (0, 1)‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G q (1, 0)) (fderiv ℝ G q (0, 1)) ^ 2) * h (G q)
